title: Monday Daily Practice
subtitle: Trend words, passive, and intro + overview for 3 charts
source: Bài tự soạn, biểu đồ mới (không trùng Writing 4 và handout P2)
intro: Làm lần lượt 4 bước, khoảng 60 phút. Bước 3 là bài Writing của tuần: intro và overview cho 3 biểu đồ, có công thức và ảnh. Hạn nộp 23:30 cùng ngày: đủ và đúng hạn được 20 Meow, muộn hoặc làm một nửa được 10 Meow.
send_today: Hoàn thành 4 bước trên web. Bài Writing ở bước 3 được thầy chấm, voice note ở bước 4 được gửi tự động khi bấm Nộp bài.

steps.title: Step 1 · Trend words
steps.instructions: Điền từ trong khung: surge · plunge · recover · rocket · plateau · bottom out · steep decline · marginal change. Đổi dạng từ nếu cần.

items.label: 1. After the new bus line opened, the number of passengers began to ______.
2. Shares ______ by 30% in one week after the bad news.
3. Visitors fell after the flood, but the number began to ______ slowly.
4. Prices ______ in 2021, then fell back in 2022.
5. Sales stayed at a ______ for about a year before they rose again.
6. Unemployment ______ in 2020 and then started to fall.
7. There was a ______ in the number of students after the school closed.
8. The rent went up only a little. It was a ______.

steps.title: Step 2 · Passive: was / were + V3 (past simple)
steps.instructions: Viết lại câu bằng bị động quá khứ đơn. Điền đúng V3 của động từ trong ngoặc. Ví dụ: The council built a bridge. → A bridge was built by the council.

items.label: 1. The council opened a new park in 2019. → A new park ______ in 2019. (open)
2. Farmers grew rice on these fields for 50 years. → Rice ______ on these fields for 50 years. (grow)
3. The company converted the old warehouse into flats. → The old warehouse ______ into flats. (convert)
4. Workers demolished the market in 2018. → The market ______ in 2018. (demolish)
5. The city expanded the school in 2022. → The school ______ in 2022. (expand)

steps.title: Step 3 · Writing: intro + overview cho 3 biểu đồ
steps.instructions: Đọc công thức trước khi viết. Mỗi biểu đồ viết 1 intro và 1 overview (2 câu, không số liệu). Overview: câu 1 nêu xu hướng chính, câu 2 nêu khác biệt. Không viết lại từng số trong overview. Ảnh hiển thị ngay dưới hướng dẫn của từng biểu đồ.

open.q: Biểu đồ 1 (đường): học viên 3 khóa tiếng Anh, 2016–2023. Viết intro và overview.
open.model: Intro: The given line graph illustrates the number of students enrolled in three English courses at a language centre over an eight-year period, commencing from 2016. Overview: Overall, there was an increase in the number of beginner students, while a steady decline was seen in advanced students, with the most dramatic rise being seen in the beginner course. It is also clear that intermediate students consistently had the highest figures until 2019, although beginners overtook them from 2020 onwards.

open.q: Biểu đồ 2 (cột): tiền thuê phòng 4 khu, 2015 và 2025. Viết intro và overview.
open.model: Intro: The given bar chart compares the average monthly rent for a one-bedroom flat in four districts over a ten-year period, commencing from 2015. Overview: Overall, there was an increase in rent in all four districts, with the most dramatic rise being seen in Riverside. It is also clear that Central consistently had the highest rent throughout the period.

open.q: Biểu đồ 3 (bảng): xe bán ra của 3 hãng, 2019–2023. Viết intro và overview.
open.model: Intro: The given table illustrates the number of cars sold by three car brands over a five-year period, commencing from 2019. Overview: Overall, there was an increase in the number of cars sold by Vinamotor and Sun Motors, while a steady decline was seen in Hanoi Auto. It is also clear that Vinamotor consistently had the highest figures throughout the period, although Sun Motors rose the most.

images.alt: Line graph: students enrolled in three English courses, 2016 to 2023
Bar chart: average monthly rent in four districts, 2015 and 2025
Table: number of cars sold by three brands, 2019 to 2023

steps.title: Step 4 · Đọc to một overview
steps.instructions: Ghi âm 20 giây: đọc to overview của biểu đồ 1, không nhìn giấy.
steps.note: Thầy nghe nhịp đọc và âm cuối của was, were, -ed.
